note: Both sets capture the core Nitinol facts (martensite/austenite structures, 4-5% strain, 25,000 PSI force, 2-5% typical contraction, 55-65% Ni / 44-55% Ti) and both repeat the same two fabricated values (hysteresis '20-50C' instead of 25-50C, and '20,000 PSI' instead of 25,000 PSI). Set A adds extra problems: a vague 'Titanium composition: not specified percent' claim, a mislabeled 'strain stress' for the 25,000 PSI force, and it misbinds the 15-30C transition range to the 'Harvest Shade Screen' when the source says 'in the context of the linear diffuser'. Set B keeps that condition correct and its commercial transition claim (90C) is merely incomplete rather than wrong, though it also misquotes 'mechanical stress' for 'mechanical force'. Overall B is the more faithful set despite heavy duplication in both.
